headline: Anthropic nears $900B valuation as Mythos hunts 10,000 bugs
body: Two Anthropic stories pulled in different directions. Project Glasswing reported that Claude Mythos Preview and about 50 partners flagged over 10,000 serious software vulnerabilities in 30 days, including a 27-year-old OpenBSD bug. That shows rising capability but also AI being used to make systems safer, so it lowers Catastrophic Risk, easing Self-Destruction and Reversion. Japan said its government and banks will get Mythos for cyber defence. Meanwhile Anthropic raised over $30B at about a $900B valuation and OpenAI filed confidentially for an IPO, a clear step up in Power Concentration that favours Enslaved God. Protector God moved above Egalitarian Utopia. Horizon Balance edged up 0.02 to 0.8.
movers_note: Enslaved God +0.8, from the Anthropic funding round and OpenAI IPO filing (+0.48) and Glasswing (+0.39), partly offset by fading earlier news (-0.03). Zookeeper +0.6, from Glasswing (+0.32) and the Anthropic funding round and OpenAI IPO filing (+0.32), partly offset by fading earlier news (-0.05). Self-Destruction -0.6, mostly from Glasswing (-0.38) and Japan's Mythos access (-0.16).
coming_up: Japan's government is due to get access to Claude Mythos later in May
